d: Yadi aap 50 ki umr par kar chuke hain aur prostet ki samasya se pareshan hain, to yah vidiyo aapke lie bahut mahatvapurn hai. is vidiyo men, amit aapko 5 saral aur prabhavi yogasan bataenge jo prostet svasthy men sudhar karne aur sanbandhit samasyaon se rahat dilane men madad kar sakte hain. ye aasan na keval prostet granthi ki malish karte hain, balki pelvik kshetr men rakt ke sanchar ko bhi barhate hain. in abhyason ko niymit rup se din men do bar karne se aapko rat men bar-bar toylet jane ki samasya se rahat mil sakti hai.
